ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Microsoft Office Startup Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of Microsoft Office files inside of one of the default startup folders in order to achieve persistence.

sequences.query: (((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Word\\\\STARTUP.*") OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Office.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\STARTUP.*"))) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.doc$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.docm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.docx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dot$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dotm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.rtf$"))) OR ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Excel\\\\XLSTART.*") OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Office.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\XLSTART.*"))) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.xls$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlt$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xltm$")))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\EXCEL\\\.exe$")))
